goal-rm024-p2-024a-2026-07-20.source_label: attached goal objective approved by human
topics: Use context classifications public, internal by default, sensitive, and restricted.
Treat secrets and credentials as restricted; reject provider handoff fail closed and never use redaction as authorization.
Create a fresh immutable ContextEnvelope for every attempt.
Do not add persistence, automatic deletion, or a cleanup executor in P2-024A.
Require explicit policy expiry, timezone-aware UTC, an injected clock, and reject use when now is at or after expires_at.
Defer concrete retention durations, quarantine, deletion, tombstones, and secure erase to RM-027A/B.
Bind schema version, context, run, assignment, attempt, parent context, source hash, producer runtime, and consumer runtime lineage.
Support Python local runtime only and reject Codex bridge, unknown runtime, and unknown schema versions fail closed.
Preserve AgentContext, provider, CLI, run/resume/show, and artifact compatibility; keep P2-024A as additive internal API.
Do not implement external providers, solvers, dependencies, RM-010 through RM-013, RM-027 cleanup, or parallel execution.

acceptance_criteria: A strict versioned immutable ContextPolicy and ContextEnvelope bind classification, retention-policy ID, UTC expiry, exact allowlist, canonical payload/source/policy hashes, and run/assignment/attempt/runtime lineage.

The actual orchestrator-to-provider path validates integrity, expiry, lineage, runtime, assignment allowlist parity, restricted secrets, and provider availability before delivering a fresh AgentContext copy.

Unknown fields, versions, runtimes, dotted-path allowlists, tampering, replay, expired context, and restricted provider handoff fail closed without enabling external providers or writing context lifecycle state.
Existing AgentContext and provider signatures, LocalProvider behavior, CLI exit codes, run/resume/show, and existing artifact meanings remain compatible.
Unit, property/metamorphic, integration, adversarial, CLI, roadmap, doctor, and canonical quality gates pass with no new dependency.

status_vocabulary.proposed: Candidate not yet accepted into an implementation plan.
status_vocabulary.planned: Accepted scope with no implementation work in progress.
status_vocabulary.in_progress: An explicitly scoped implementation is active.
status_vocabulary.blocked: Progress is stopped by a recorded concrete blocker.
status_vocabulary.completed: Acceptance criteria have tracked code, test, or artifact evidence.
status_vocabulary.superseded: Replaced by another RM and terminal unless governance is amended.

implementation_milestones.scope: Context envelope policy, schema, ownership, lineage, and allowlists.
Typed pure phase services with serial execution and no persistence integration.
Strict budget schema, fake clock, serial accounting, and retry classification.
Classification, retention, expiry, quarantine, and disposition policy/schema only.
Immutable revision storage, manifest, transaction, lock, recovery claim, and revision CAS foundation.
Phase service integration with durable transition ordering and fault injection.
Durable usage/resume, reservations, concurrency, cancellation, and RM-028 interface.
Completion marker, verified reader/status mapping, migration, and lifecycle hooks.
Approval actor, authority, action digest, request/decision idempotency, and CAS transaction.
Authorized cleanup executor, dry-run digest, CAS, receipt, tombstone, and reconciliation.
Resume integration, legacy reissue, expiry/revocation, and lifecycle binding.
Approved isolation boundary, durable external-effect state, cancellation, and reconciliation.

items.title: Capability matrix and documentation synchronization
items.objective: Keep implemented, disabled, unavailable, and planned capability claims aligned with executable behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor, documentation, and code expose the same capability states.
items.status_reason: Phase 0 capability truthfulness is implemented and contract-tested.

items.title: Provider capability truthfulness
items.objective: Never infer outbound availability from package or key presence alone.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAI provider remains disabled until outbound analyze is implemented and approved.
items.status_reason: The four package/key combinations are tested and do not overstate capability.

items.title: Canonical quality gate and temp policy
items.objective: Make the four local quality gates reproducible without unsafe shared temp cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Pytest, Ruff lint, Ruff format check, and mypy run in the supported local workspace.
items.status_reason: Canonical commands and workspace-local pytest temp isolation are implemented.

items.title: Priority mathematical branch coverage
items.objective: Exercise high-risk numeric, normalization, evidence, and provider branches with known outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Priority failure, fallback, warning, and boundary branches have regression tests.
items.status_reason: The approved priority branches and regressions are implemented.

items.title: Exactness and numeric tolerance specification
items.objective: Define exact, exact-under-model, floating-verified, approximate, and unavailable results without false precision.
acceptance_criteria: Contract v2 records numeric exactness, tolerance, model qualifiers, and executable verification.
items.status_reason: Contract v2 exactness and runtime verification are present.

items.title: Single source for typed tool contracts
items.objective: Keep all registered tool input, output, assumptions, limits, and versions in one typed definition set.
acceptance_criteria: Registry, generated manifest, and generated documentation have full contract parity.
items.status_reason: All 20 tools expose contract version 2.0.0 with typed schemas.

items.title: Mathematical oracle and metamorphic test pack
items.objective: Cross-check calculators with known answers, independent local oracles, invariants, and metamorphic relations.
acceptance_criteria: Priority calculators have deterministic oracle, boundary, and reproducibility coverage.
items.status_reason: Local oracle and metamorphic regression coverage is implemented.

items.title: Offline public preflight
items.objective: Audit tracked worktree and Git history without network access or destructive history changes.
acceptance_criteria: Tracked/history secret, PII, license, artifact, and exclusion checks fail closed.

topics: offline audit only; no publication or history rewrite

items.status_reason: The offline scanner and synthetic fixtures are implemented; publication remains a separate decision.

items.title: Complete Markdown ToolResult metadata
items.objective: Render ToolResult status, exactness, assumptions, warnings, uncertainty, errors, and reproduction data without silent loss.
acceptance_criteria: JSON and Markdown preserve the required result metadata for every result state.
items.status_reason: Golden coverage protects the required Markdown result metadata.

items.title: Orchestrator phase services
items.objective: Split orchestration into typed, independently testable phases while preserving public behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Pure phase services do not mutate state or artifacts; the orchestrator alone requests transitions after durable writes.
items.status_reason: Implementation is intentionally not started; the draft contract is conditionally frozen subject to its listed human approvals.

items.title: Budget, retry, timeout, cancellation, and concurrency semantics
items.objective: Make every active budget field finite, enforceable, auditable, and fail-closed or remove it from active configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown, zero, or over-cap cost prevents external calls while free local execution remains valid; retries are typed and idempotent; unconfirmed cancellation is not success.

topics: whether parallel deliberation is a product capability

items.status_reason: Current ordinary orchestration does not enforce several declared fields; implementation is not started.

items.title: Versioned run manifest and failure atomicity
items.objective: Distinguish completed, incomplete, corrupt, unsupported, and resumable runs with integrity evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Immutable revision artifacts preserve every prior verified revision; a terminal marker is written last inside the revision and an atomic current pointer is published only after readers verify run ID, manifest, payload inventory, sizes, and hashes.
items.status_reason: The current v1 marker is not validated and whole-run completion is not atomic; implementation is not started.

items.title: Approval and resume contract hardening
items.objective: Make approval decisions authoritative, conflict-safe, auditable, and idempotently resumable.
acceptance_criteria: Existing idempotency outcomes are resolved before stale-revision checks; unknown, duplicate, stale, unauthorized, concurrent, and approve/reject conflicts otherwise fail as structured all-or-nothing decisions bound to an action digest.
items.status_reason: Current local approvals have no actor, revision, CAS, or action digest; implementation is not started.

items.title: Versioned normalization grammar
items.objective: Version the supported conservative grammar and preserve parser provenance in run artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Supported and unsupported syntax, locale, warnings, and parser version are explicit and round-trip tested.
tests: round-trip, malformed, Unicode, unknown-key, and resource-boundary tests
items.status_reason: Accepted roadmap scope; not implemented.

items.title: Hand rule profiles and side-pot accounting
items.objective: Define selected rule profiles for raises, all-ins, uncalled bets, side pots, and rake timing.
acceptance_criteria: Supported rule profiles and unsupported cases match schema, documentation, and golden ledgers.
tests: multiway side-pot, short-call, folded-contribution, and rule-profile golden tests

topics: site, jurisdiction, and game rule profiles

items.status_reason: Accepted roadmap scope; not implemented.

items.title: Range grammar and provenance
items.objective: Add only approved range syntax with source and game-condition provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Ambiguity, overlap, blocker, weight, and provenance mismatches fail explicitly.
tests: range parser, normalization, blocker, ambiguity, and provenance isolation tests
items.status_reason: Accepted roadmap scope; not implemented.

items.title: Executable evaluation harness
items.objective: Turn evaluation metric names into versioned datasets, scorers, thresholds or review protocols, and reproducible result artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Every metric records dataset/license/hash, scorer/version, direction, aggregation, denominator policy, threshold or human rubric, commit/config hashes, and per-case outcomes.
items.status_reason: evals/metrics.json names metrics but has no executable runner or baseline.

items.title: Pre-release readiness
items.objective: Establish reproducible build and distribution evidence after Phase 1 and before any pre-release tag.
acceptance_criteria: Approved OS/Python matrix, clean build/install, wheel/sdist contents, CLI/package-data smoke, license inventory, artifact SHA-256, and offline preflight are tied to one candidate commit.
items.status_reason: The phase order is corrected, but build, matrix, license, and artifact evidence do not yet exist.

items.title: Stable release gate
items.objective: Gate any stable tag on completed Phase 2 compatibility, migration, and source-to-artifact evidence.
acceptance_criteria: SemVer, version/tag/changelog parity, migration, deprecation, supported stable matrix, and artifact/source commit mapping are verified for one candidate.
items.status_reason: This gate is intentionally after Phase 2 and is not implemented or evaluated.

items.title: Decision-gated OpenAI provider
items.objective: Connect an external provider only after data, model, trace, cost, timeout, and approval boundaries are authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Only approved data is sent and model/version/reasoning, trace policy, cost, timeout, structured output, and failure are recorded.
items.status_reason: The outbound provider remains disabled; implementation is decision-gated.

items.title: External solver qualification adapter
items.objective: Qualify external solver results without promoting partial, mismatched, or non-converged output to GTO or equilibrium.
acceptance_criteria: Typed status, full game/tree/rake/stack/range/version identity, executable/license and I/O hashes, resource approval, convergence definitions and trajectory, exploitability evidence, and tiny-game comparison are required.
items.status_reason: Only an honest unavailable adapter exists; RM-028 is a hard dependency for external execution.

items.title: Multiway and PLO equity feasibility
items.objective: Measure algorithm, error, oracle, license, and resource feasibility before any production commitment.
acceptance_criteria: Small exact cases, complexity, hard caps, oracle provenance, and expected error support a separate adoption decision.
items.status_reason: Research feasibility only; not implemented.

items.title: Small imperfect-information research
items.objective: Reproduce known toy-game results without claiming general NLHE equilibrium capability.
acceptance_criteria: Known equilibrium, regret trend, and best-response/exploitability cross-check are reproducible and labeled experimental.
items.status_reason: Research-only roadmap item; not implemented.

items.title: Roadmap and status single source of truth
items.objective: Provide a package-resource-configured, tracked, machine-readable canonical RM state independent of ignored user materials; distribution inclusion remains an RM-018A check.
acceptance_criteria: Schema, vocabulary, transitions, unique IDs, DAG, evidence, capability references, doctor summary, and generated documentation are contract-tested from any CWD.

items.title: Codex and Python agent runtime conformance
items.objective: Define versioned conformance fixtures for assignment, context, tool allowlist, approval, result, and execution-record semantics across separate runtimes.
acceptance_criteria: Version negotiation and fixture conformance cover assignment, context, result, error, approval, and audit semantics; capability remains unavailable until an actual bridge passes the contract.

topics: whether to implement a bridge or retain conformance-only separation

items.status_reason: Approved as a roadmap candidate only; both runtimes remain separate.
relations: Extends the execution-surface boundary recorded by RM-001 without claiming current interoperability.

items.title: Framework extension SPI
items.objective: Define explicit, versioned extension registration without treating arbitrary imports as a security boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Extension ID, type, API version, capability and data permissions, lifecycle methods, duplicate/incompatible rejection, and health/cancel/close semantics are explicit; auto-import is not required.
items.status_reason: Approved as a roadmap candidate only; no extension SPI exists.
relations: May support RM-019/RM-020 adapters but never replaces their approval or isolation requirements.

items.title: Local data lifecycle
items.objective: Define versioned classification, retention, expiry, disposition, recovery, and audit receipts for local artifacts and contexts.
acceptance_criteria: RM-027A freezes policy/schema before storage; RM-027B runs only after RM-012/P2-013A and requires actor authority, an approved dry-run action digest, revision CAS, active/pending protection, idempotent receipts/tombstones, and partial-failure reconciliation without claiming secure erase absent platform evidence.
items.status_reason: Approved as a roadmap candidate only; current local artifacts have no lifecycle policy.
relations: RM-027A provides policy/schema before RM-012; destructive RM-027B follows RM-012 and P2-013A authorization.

items.title: Isolated solver and provider job control
items.objective: Provide durable, approval-bound process isolation and hard-stop evidence for non-cooperative external jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical argv plus transitive interpreter/library/image identity, approved secret references, minimal OS identity, closed stdin/handles, filesystem read/write allowlists with link-escape defense, default-deny network egress with destination allowlists, wall-clock kill, process-tree cleanup, CPU/memory/output caps, remote-cancel state, durable launch/effect_unknown/reconciliation states, and approval action digest are enforced.
items.status_reason: Approved as a roadmap candidate only; cooperative in-process cancellation is not a hard stop.
relations: Hard dependency for any RM-019/RM-020 execution that claims timeout or cancellation guarantees.
